purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: Natural completed-study language such as 'tagit examen' can fall into a generic work/student route, leaving the user without a source-grounded first-unemployed-day action and creating risk that registration is confused with automatic a-kassa eligibility.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Detect only bounded completed-study transition language, pass a coarse study_to_work focus without raw story text, ask whether a job starts immediately and then whether unemployment is today or later, and keep a-kassa entitlement as a separate decision by the a-kassa.
